🌈
I'm getting the same error on my Vercel deployment. FWIW I can build locally (Docusaurus 2.0)
Anyone has an idea why this breaks existing production builds which contained no changes?

> I'm getting the same error on my Vercel deployment. FWIW I can build locally (Docusaurus 2.0)

This is specifically a regression targeting mini-css-extract-plugin and a few other import-related scenarios. Production builds will see this instead of local development builds (which do not use the plugin). Fix in progress we just need to add a test case which will cover this scenario so we can confidently make changes to this code in the future. I'll ship a bugfix patch today once finished. 

Thanks for the patience all 😊
If you have come here because your CI builds have been failing today, the following would be a very good read: https://github.com/yarnpkg/yarn/issues/4147
